findings.description: In the same frame, the dancer's left arm is fully extended in a straight vertical line overhead, but her reflection shows that arm bent at the elbow with the hand arched/curved over toward the head; her other arm also reads at a different angle (real arm rising above horizontal vs reflection at/below horizontal). A real mirror must show the exact mirrored pose at the same instant, so the reflection is animating a different arm shape. The same straight-vs-arched mismatch recurs at 0:08, while the bent-arm pose at 0:04 matches, indicating the reflection's arm motion systematically diverges whenever the real arm goes fully straight overhead.
